title: 妖怪変化もなんのその！

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! No wonder everyone's been talking about this haunted house. I-it's terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, Kita, tell me how you're feeling! Which parts really scared you? When were you the most rattled?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser rapidly scribbles notes while a rattled Kitasan Black recounts her experience. This all started a few hours ago…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm, you can't make the haunted house scary enough, you say?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Right. I want to make it the main attraction of the shopping district's Gratitude Festival, but I can't make it scary enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And seeing as I always shop here, I want to help! But, well… all my ideas are mediocre at best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A h-haunted house, huh? Yeah… Yeah, I can h-handle that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: L-let's do some research on what makes them so scary! Don't worry, you can count on me… b-because I'm terrified of monsters and ghoulies!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But it's precisely because I'm terrified of that kinda stuff that I'll be a good reference! I'm sure I can be of help with this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I really want to see this festival work out, so I'll do everything I can to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I'm so sorry for putting you through this, but thank you, thank you! Tell me if it's too much, though, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we head out to research spooky things that might help raise the fear factor in the haunted house…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not so scary right now. In fact, the blue light actually looks quite pleasant… Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-hey, do you guys hear something? It sounds like a child's voice…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's… play… tag…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: AHHH! Zombie, zombie, zombiiieee! ARGGGHHH! They're everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There are so many! It sure is scary being chased by a whole horde of them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Maaan, that was horrifying! No wonder everyone is talking about this movie!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can still see how the character's long hair and smile looked, reflected in the window. A-and then there was the… Urrrgh! It was so scary!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won't ever be able to look through a window at night again! Or under my bed… or at the bathroom mirror, for that matter!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, their smile and hair looked extra spine-chilling mirrored in the glass! Just thinking of that part is making my hand shake as I write!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's time to call it quits…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I'm still good! Come on, let's hurry to the next thing while I'm still conscious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black puts on a brave face for the sake of the shopping district despite being scared out of her mind.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: R-r-right! If we use the material we gathered as a reference, we'll be sure to make the haunted house even scarier!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much for your help! I managed to get loads of good ideas! All that's left is…

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Urgh! I won't let anyone say our haunted house isn't up to scratch after all the hard work we put into it! Hang on a second!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Okay, all the final touches are complete! Let me know your honest opinions!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Got it! This is my final duty… I'll bear witness to the culmination of everyone's blood, sweat, and tears!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eep! I-I saw someone peeking through the window just now…
RAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! N-nooo! They're chasing me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: K-Kita! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: I heard you scream, but… Well, what'd you think of the haunted house?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It scared the life outta me! My heart is still racing at a million miles a minute!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I thought I was alone until I saw a ghost standing silently and smiling at me! And then a whole crowd of them chased after me at the very end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine! This haunted house is guaranteed to be a huge hit! In fact, I'm giving it my seal of approval!
choice_data_list: I can't wait for the day of the event!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm sure visitors will appreciate how much hard work went into this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Most importantly, I'm sure the guests will be able to tell just how much fun we want them to have as well!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! We couldn't have done all this without your help! We're going to put on one heck of a festival for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get a warm, pleasant feeling watching Kitasan Black interacting with the spirited shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, exactly! Sometimes having a weakness can actually be useful!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But… well…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: When it's time for the actual festival… make sure you stay by my side, okay?
